payout_quote: For each friend or family member who makes a deposit of at least $1,000, you will both receive $100 in a stock or ETF of your choice subject to the 'Terms and Conditions' below.
steps: Hold a Public Investing brokerage account that is funded and in good standing.
Copy your unique referral link from the app (Rewards button > Copy link / Invite from contacts).
Share the link with personal friends or family members with whom you have a direct, personal relationship (with their consent).
Your friend uses your link to open and get approved for a Public brokerage account, and successfully deposits at least $1,000 as an initial one-time deposit.
Claim your reward in the app within 30 days (Public alerts you when you are cleared to claim); choose a stock or ETF from the available selection.
catches: High bar on the friend's side: they must make a $1,000+ initial one-time deposit - most casual referrals will not qualify.
The $100 reward is a fractional share of a stock/ETF, not cash; the cash value cannot be withdrawn for 12 months after claiming or the account may face an early withdrawal fee of up to $100.
Cap: you may earn up to $500 of rewards through promotions and offers on the Public app, then lose reward eligibility.
You have 30 days to claim the reward or it expires (cannot be revived).
Personal use only - no spam, mass emails, commercial advertising, or publicly selling/buying referral codes; violations void referrals.
No guarantee the offer will be paid; Public can change or terminate the program at any time without notice.
The cash value of the reward may be reported as 'Other Income' on a Form 1099-Misc.
biggest_catch: Your friend must deposit $1,000+ in one initial deposit - and the $100 is a fractional share you cannot withdraw as cash for 12 months.
eligibility: Existing Public Investing members with a funded brokerage account in good standing; US residents; refers only personal friends/family without an existing Public account.
timing: Public alerts you when cleared to claim; claim within 30 days; cash value of the reward locked from withdrawal for 12 months after claiming.
